nativeSource.name: Allwinner H3 DDR3 16x1
nativeSource.scope: All named DDR signal nets incident to CPU or RAM, including passive endpoints. Power, VREF, ZQ and unconnected nets excluded. Existing traces, vias and zones removed. Board uses edge bounding box. No timing or impedance constraints invented.
notes: These are the captured routing inputs, not newly simplified two-chip layouts.
KiCad pad primitives are retained as separate obstacles; some package footprints contain multiple primitives per ball.
Bus metadata restricts source signal layers only; no timing, skew, impedance or differential-pair constraints are invented.

scope: Three native DDR subsystem components, all 445 pads and 53 selected signal nets. This diagnostic captures the actual first Core routing callback and deliberately stops before routing any copper. It does not claim a complete route or DDR timing qualification.
